notifications.title: Autumn has come
notifications.body: The harvest is in and the ground is firm: every soldier holds 20% better. The Order marches half as often again; the nomads go home to winter.

notifications.title: Boatwrights wait at (-6, 4)
notifications.body: Send them resources from your villages, and they build a boat that carries armies and caravans fast along the river, with a bounty of at least 1750 resources for everyone. If nobody does, the next horde from the north hates you the more.

notifications.title: Your army was thrown back from the horde's encampment
notifications.body: 0 of the horde fell before it set out, 2 of ours. The next horde hates us the more for it.

notifications.title: Summer has come
notifications.body: The fields ripen: twice the grain. The steppe riders ride twice as often; the Order's armies, slow in the heat, half as often.

notifications.title: Captives are held at (2, 0)
notifications.body: Clear the camp to free them before they are taken away, for a bounty of at least 1400 resources. If they are taken, the next horde from the north hates you the more.

notifications.title: The campaign against the Order of the One Throne is over
notifications.body: 1 of 2 battles won; 346 resources brought home. The full report is in the Raid tab.

notifications.title: Your raid was beaten at the Fortress of the Order
notifications.body: It turns for home with 346 resources; 6 of its men fell.

notifications.title: Your raid won the battle of the Vineyard Terraces
notifications.body: 9 of the enemy fell; it carries 346 resources and marches on.

notifications.title: Your army cleared the bandit camp at (-2, 5)
Done: Clear your first camp
notifications.body: Claim its reward from the quest card.

notifications.title: The Builders' Barrow rises
notifications.body: The first builders sleep in the Builders' Barrow with their mark, the rune that bound the old span to Yav. Their dead still guard it: break through and bring the rune back, or no stone will hold the new span. It is marked on the map at (0, -5).
